methods.name: RIM
methods.description: Each RIM’s dynamics should only be affected by RIMs which are deemed relevant.

methods.name: Modular Computation Flow
methods.description: Each RIM should have its own dynamics operating by default, in the absence of interaction with other RIMs.

methods.name: Modular Parameterization
methods.description: The total number of parameters (i.e. weights) can be reduced since the RIMs can specialize on simple sub-problems.

methods.name: RNN
methods.description: allows for such an RNN to learn long-term dependencies without vanishing or exploding gradients.

methods.name: Consciousness Prior
methods.description: This is based on the inductive bias of a sparse graphical model describing the interactions between high-level variables, each factor involving few variables and capaturing an independent mechanism, and using attention to select only a subset of high-level variables to interact together at any particular time during inference.

methods.name: Recurrent Entity Networks
methods.description: can be viewed as a set of separate recurrent models whose hidden states store the memory slots. These hidden states are either ﬁxed by the gates, or modiﬁed through a simple RNN-style update.

methods.name: RIMs

methods.name: LSTM
